title: Grant and same-block Probe are serialized until GrantAck

source.statement: After a slave issues a Grant for a block, it should not issue Probes on that block until the corresponding GrantAck is received.

scope: CoupledL2 SourceB and GrantBuffer same-block serialization
trigger: a SourceB Probe would fire while GrantBuffer reports a same-block Grant awaiting GrantAck
expectation: a same-block Probe is not issued while the matching Grant remains pending
preconditions: GrantBuffer grantStatus entries are valid for Grants awaiting GrantAck
binding_requirements: grant_pending is a Bool derived from SourceB same-block Grant conflict
probe_fire is a Bool derived from the SourceB B-channel issue point
environment_assumptions: the profile observes SourceB after preflight cleanup has removed inherited formal checks
